lines.say: Your app asked the server, any new messages? The server didn't answer. For thirty seconds. On purpose.
lines.show: Your app asked the server, *any new messages?* The server didn't answer. For [thirty seconds.] On purpose.

lines.say: Without it, your app keeps asking, and most of the time it hears nothing new. That's a lot of wasted trips.
lines.show: Without it, your app *keeps asking,* and most of the time it hears *nothing new.* That's a lot of [wasted trips.]

lines.say: Long polling flips that. The server holds your question and waits.
lines.show: [Long polling] flips that. The server *holds your question* and waits.

lines.say: The moment a message arrives, it answers. Your app shows it, and asks again straight away.
lines.show: The moment a message arrives, it *answers.* Your app shows it, and [asks again] straight away.

lines.say: If nothing happens before a time limit, say thirty seconds, the server answers nothing yet, and your app asks again.
lines.show: If nothing happens before a *time limit,* say 30 seconds, the server answers [nothing yet,] and your app asks again.

lines.say: Like a kid asking are we there yet every minute, versus asking once and getting the answer the moment you arrive.
lines.show: Like a kid asking *are we there yet* every minute, versus asking once and getting the answer [the moment you arrive.]

lines.say: Telegram bots can get messages this way, using plain web requests.
lines.show: *Telegram bots* can get messages this way, using plain *web requests.*

lines.say: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI skipped.
lines.show: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI [skipped.]
